title: Text Size Setting
description:
Adds a [b]Text Size[/b] option to the game's own settings menu so you can make text easier to read.

[h2]How to use[/h2]
Open [b]Settings > General[/b] and use the [b]-[/b] / [b]+[/b] buttons on the [b]Text Size[/b] row. Pick anything from 70% to 200% in 10% steps. The change applies right away and is remembered next time you play.

[h2]What it changes[/h2]
Text across the game's interface: menus, tooltips, the HUD, events and more. Text never spills out of its button, box or frame: where space is tight, it grows only as much as fits.

[h2]Compatibility[/h2]
No other mods required. Doesn't change gameplay or saves. Unsubscribe to remove it and your text goes back to normal.
changeNote: Text no longer spills out of buttons, boxes and frames at large sizes: it grows as much as the space allows.
